title: The CLI tests cover what the differential sweep checked
body:
`sufr/tests/cli.rs` runs the binary through `assert_cmd` in 59 tests. Each subcommand has a helper (`create`, `count`, `extract`, `list`, `locate`, `summarize`) that runs one fixture with one set of arguments and compares stdout against a string or a file in `data/expected`. `count` and `locate` also loop over the memory flags, none, `-l` and `-v`.

The differential sweep is `tmp-claude/2026-11-02-refactor-survey/alphabet/sweep.sh`, an untracked script from the 2026-11-02 refactor survey. It runs one binary 7,376 times over every fixture and compares stdout, exit code and written `.sufr` bytes against the same runs from the previous commit's binary. Jack decided on 2026-11-03 to drop it. The CLI tests take over what it checked, within reason, and then the script goes.

What the sweep runs that `cli.rs` does not, per `.sufr` fixture in `data/inputs` and `data/expected`:

| area | sweep | cli.rs |
|---|---|---|
| fixtures | all 20 for every subcommand | seq1, seq3, long_dna, uniprot, uniprot_masked, and not every subcommand on each |
| queries | A C G T N AC ACG GT CGT TT T$A ACGT ACGTNNACGT$ X MK QQ ACGTA | a few per test; none with N, none past the end of the text |
| `count`, `locate`, `extract` with `-m` | `-m 1`, `-m 3`, `-m 3 -l`, `-m 2` with a query file | `-m` on locate and extract for uniprot and long_dna only |
| query file | `A C <file> GT` where the file holds `AC GT`, a tab-separated line and a blank line | one query file for count and locate |
| `extract` windows | `-p 100` past the start, `-s 0` | `-p 1`, `-s 3`, both |
| `-o` to an unwritable path | the three search subcommands | none |
| `list` | `-n 0`, `-r -p --len 2 -n 5`, `-v -r -s`, ranges `0 2-4 1,3 999999`, malformed `3-1` and `+1` | single flags on sufr1, one out-of-range rank, `-l` rejected |
| missing files | `count`, `summarize`, `list` on a missing `.sufr`; `count` with `/` as the query | none |
| `create` | 12 flag sets on each `.fa`, with seed masks `1101`, `101`, `11011`, and `-n 4`; the `.sufr` bytes compared | 14 fixtures compared against `data/expected`; seed masks and `-n` only where a fixture exists |

Of the sweep's 7,376 runs at 6edc011, 6,293 exit 0, 829 exit 1, 243 panic and 11 are clap usage errors. The panics are sufr-54d2c8, sufr-626e7f and sufr-71e671. They stay bugs and are not pinned.

## Proposal

Add tests to `cli.rs` for each row of the table, over the fixtures and flags that reach different code rather than the full product. The error rows pin the exit code and the stderr line. The `create` row adds seed mask and `-n` cases only where a `data/expected` fixture can be made with `mk_test_files.py` (see the memory `expected-fixtures-write-lcp` before regenerating anything).

## Cost

- The sentence in `CLAUDE.md` under "Behaviour that is frozen during reorganization" that names the differential sweep is rewritten to name the CLI tests.
- The script and the memory `benchmark-and-sweep-scripts` go once the tests land.
- sufr-7f37d4 asked what level of sweep a change needs. This issue answers it and that one is closed.

## Open

- Whether exit codes for the 829 error runs are worth pinning beyond the missing-file cases, or whether the error text alone is the contract.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/1ddc0e5b
notes.text: Jack decided on 2026-11-03 that this runs after the code changes already on the board, not before. A ranked list of the gaps that matter is being drawn up in conversation; the rows Jack picks from it become the scope, and the table in the body is the full inventory, not the plan.
